tasks.short: Inspect biomass equipment and record and report damage or mechanical problems

steps.what: Inspect the actual biomass plant or processing equipment and capture observed damage, symptoms, equipment identifiers and conditions
inputs: Actual equipment and current inspection scope
Existing plant rounds and maintenance log system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual technician observations and captured equipment and condition references

steps.what: Write the actual damage or mechanical-problem entry using native equipment fields and the technician's actual observations
inputs: Actual observations and selected equipment references captured in s1
outputs: Draft actual inspection problem record and report text

steps.what: Assess the observed problem and check the complete final record and report, urgency, recipient and actual follow-up request
inputs: Complete actual draft from s2
Original inspection observations and current plant reporting procedure
outputs: Exact checked final problem record and report with human-selected urgency and recipient

steps.what: Commit the exact checked inspection problem record in the existing plant log
inputs: Exact completed record checked in s3
outputs: Saved actual inspection problem entry

steps.what: Send the exact checked problem report to the selected internal operations or maintenance recipient
inputs: Exact report, urgency and recipient checked in s3
outputs: Actual internal problem report sent, with delivery status

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} equipment fields for the actual inspection entry and report. Keep physical inspection, problem assessment, substantive wording and the complete final report check human, with separate record commit and internal send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inspection entries can repeat equipment identifiers already selected during the round.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rounds and maintenance forms can reuse exact equipment fields without inventing the observed defect.
tasks.still_hard: Damage severity and immediate operational consequences require current plant knowledge and direct observation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice abnormal equipment behaviour and choose the actual urgency and recipient.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native plant rounds forms can reuse equipment fields, while inspection findings and mechanical problem assessment require actual observations.

assumptions: Shares describe an illustrative non-emergency inspection with an actual record and internal report, not measured labour or the supplied prior.
The technician captures actual observations and selects equipment in s1. No structured defect code, severity label, sensor diagnosis or report text is provided for free.
Only repeated fixed fields reduce s2. All actual problem wording, triage and complete meaning checks remain. Native configuration already present is baseline and earns no new saving.
The full final record and report exist before s3. Edits or changed conditions invalidate the gate. Save is negligible and no saving is claimed for save or send.

Existing emergency action and reporting procedures retain priority and effort; this change does not delay urgent reporting. No repair, shutdown, control write or automatically raised work order is silently performed.
unknowns: Actual inspection entry format and urgent reporting route
research_questions: Which exact fields are actually re-entered after a biomass equipment inspection?

already_counted.description: Physical inspection, remaining actual entry work and complete problem assessment and final check remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain equipment-field mappings and test entry and recipient exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete inspection record checked in s3; edits invalidate the check.
Exact final problem report, urgency and recipient checked in s3; any change requires renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94; gross saving=6 from exact field reuse in actual writing. Deduct 2 incremental hours once for net 4. Inspection, triage, save and send remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record and report actual operational meter, instrument and gauge readings

steps.what: Read the actual field-only meters, instruments and gauges and capture their identities, values, units, times and exceptions
inputs: Actual field instruments and required reading round
Existing plant rounds and historian log system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual captured field readings and observed exceptions

steps.what: Select and verify the actual existing historian tags, time window, units and field-reading associations for this operational record
inputs: Actual existing historian readings
Captured field readings from s1 and actual logging requirements
outputs: Verified source values, explicit tag and unit mappings and chosen reporting window

steps.what: Import exact verified historian and captured field readings into the native operational log and report fields
inputs: Actual selected source values and explicit mappings from s1-s2
outputs: Draft operational record and report with source-linked readings and missing values exposed

steps.what: Write any actual exception explanation and check the entire final operational record and report against instruments, times, tags, units and recipient
inputs: Draft log and report from s3 and actual source readings
Actual human observations from s1
outputs: Exact complete checked operational record and report with actual exceptions and intended internal recipient

steps.what: Commit the exact checked operational readings record
inputs: Exact final record checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual operating data record

steps.what: Send the exact checked operational report to its selected internal recipient
inputs: Exact report and recipient checked in s4
outputs: Actual internal operational report sent with delivery result

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} transfer of exact existing historian values and technician-captured field readings into the operational log and report. Keep source selection, actual field reading, exception explanation and the entire final check human before separate save and send actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual logs can require re-keying values already in the historian or captured on a round.
tasks.enabler_now: Native historian and rounds mappings can transfer explicit tags, units and timestamps into draft records.
tasks.still_hard: A stale reading, wrong tag or unexplained field condition can make an apparently complete report wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Relate the recorded values to what is actually happening in the plant.

ambition.what: Review current operational records without repeatedly re-keying source values.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: plant historians and rounds systems can transfer exact operational readings into logs and reports using configured tags, units and timestamps.

assumptions: This conditional episode contains actual manual re-keying into an operational record and report, not a measured baseline or the supplied time prior.

Existing plant instruments produce historian readings as normal baseline work; no new instrumentation or uncounted sensor installation is assumed. The focal worker still captures field-only readings in s1 and verifies all selections and associations in s2.
Use native historian and rounds import first. Existing automated records, reports and unattended collection runtime are baseline and earn no new gain.

Missing, stale or mismatched values remain exposed and return to retained manual checks. No model infers readings or explanations, and no limit alert, control action or automatic external report occurs.
The final report and record exist before s4; changes invalidate both gates. Save is negligible and no send saving is claimed. Deduplicate any same inspection exception entry against 17860.
unknowns: Actual re-keying extent, tag quality and required report destination
research_questions: Can a trial log reproduce an observed reporting window exactly, including field-only values and exceptions?

already_counted.description: Actual field capture, source verification and complete report writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain tag and unit mappings and resolve import and source-version exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete operational record checked in s4 against actual source values; changes invalidate the check.
Exact complete operational report and internal recipient checked in s4; changes require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65; gross saving=35 from actual repeated value transfer. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 31. Existing historian runtime and same-system saves earn no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate, measure, load or mix biomass feedstock for generation

steps.what: Select and capture the actual authorised batch requirement, feedstock properties, available amounts and established calculation formula
inputs: Actual generation and batch requirement
Existing feedstock and plant operating system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
Actual source properties and established operating instructions
outputs: Human-selected actual inputs and explicit authorised formula

steps.what: Calculate exact batch quantities from the technician-selected inputs and established formula in the native calculation view
inputs: Actual captured quantities, properties and explicit formula from s1
outputs: Draft calculated batch quantities with source values and units

steps.what: Measure the actual feedstock and check the complete batch quantities, identities, loading equipment and current loading readiness
inputs: Actual feedstock, calculated quantities and original batch instruction
Current loading equipment and conditions
outputs: Actual measured quantities and exact checked current loading operation, or a stop

steps.what: Load the actual checked feedstock batch with the existing loading equipment and operating method
inputs: Exact current loading operation and actual quantities checked in s3
outputs: Actual loaded batch and observed loading outcome

steps.what: Check the actual post-loading batch, mixer state and exact authorised mixing operation against current conditions
inputs: Actual loaded batch and current equipment state from s4
Existing authorised mixing instruction
outputs: Exact checked current mixing operation, or a stop

steps.what: Carry out the exact checked mixing operation using the existing equipment and observe its actual outcome
inputs: Exact current mixing operation checked in s5
outputs: Actual mixed feedstock batch and observed outcome

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} arithmetic for explicit batch inputs and established formulas chosen by the technician. Actual measurement, loading, post-loading checks and mixing remain with the technician and existing plant controls.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual manually calculated batch repeats fixed arithmetic after its requirements and inputs are selected.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculation fields can reproduce exact formula results with visible units and source values.
tasks.still_hard: Actual feedstock variation and equipment state determine whether a calculated batch can be handled as planned.
tasks.human_edge: Check the real material and current plant conditions before each physical operation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact feedstock quantity arithmetic can use configured formulas without automating actual measurement, loading or plant control.

assumptions: This representative batch includes calculation, measurement, loading and mixing; shares are unmeasured and must not be extrapolated to the whole duty without its actual mix.
The technician selects and captures actual requirements, properties and the existing formula in s1. No free moisture measurement, stock feed or newly optimised recipe is assumed.
Native calculations are tried first. Existing recipe calculation, equipment automation and unattended mixing runtime are baseline; shares count only active human effort, not machine running time.

Each actual physical operation is separate and gated by the existing specific readiness check. Changed quantities or plant state invalidate its gate. No autonomous setpoint change or new operating method is introduced.
No separate batch record or report is established by this episode; if required, add its actual preparation, full final check and gated commit rather than hiding it inside loading.
unknowns: Actual manual arithmetic and distribution of calculation versus physical handling
research_questions: Does an observed batch still require manual calculation after actual feedstock properties are captured?

already_counted.description: Actual input capture, measurement and loading check and post-loading mixing readiness remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain authorised formulas and verify units and boundary cases after approved changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact batch, quantities, equipment and current loading operation checked in s3; changed conditions require a fresh check.
Exact current post-loading mixing operation checked in s5; changed conditions require a fresh check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual manual arithmetic. Deduct 2 incremental hours once for net 18. Existing control automation and unattended runtime earn no additional gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess the actual quality of biomass feedstock

steps.what: Identify the actual feedstock batch and quality requirements and obtain the representative material using the existing assessment method
inputs: Actual feedstock batch and existing quality requirements
outputs: Identified actual material and understood assessment criteria

steps.what: Examine and measure the actual feedstock properties under the established quality method and read any existing relevant results
inputs: Actual material and criteria from s1
Existing quality measurement and results system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual observed properties, measured readings and identified uncertainties

steps.what: Assess actual feedstock quality against the requirements, considering representativeness, contamination and uncertain results
inputs: Actual observations and results from s2 and requirements from s1
outputs: Human quality assessment and unresolved concerns

tasks.design: Keep actual feedstock quality assessment with the technician using existing {OPS_SYSTEM} results and physical observations. No new record transfer, automatic acceptance or changed physical test is established by this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: A digital result alone does not establish that the actual batch is representative or free of relevant contamination.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing quality instruments and result views already support assessment; no additional change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Sampling context, contamination and inconsistent results require actual material knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: Question whether the evidence represents the real feedstock batch.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: biomass quality assessment depends on actual material observations and relevant measurements; existing instrument results do not establish all aspects of batch suitability.

assumptions: Shares are illustrative and independent of the supplied time prior. No existing equipment runtime is counted as reducible labour.

This assessment has no established separate record, report, send or repeated arithmetic. If the actual procedure includes one, split its real work, check native settings and count its gated action before concluding zero.
No new physical test, automatic release or classifier is proposed. Existing results and quality interfaces are baseline; unavailable evidence remains an uncertainty for the technician.
unknowns: Actual quality method and whether a separate assessment record is required
research_questions: Observe one assessment for separate actual recording, calculation or reporting effort.

already_counted.description: Actual assessment requirements and final quality judgement remain counted.

incremental.description: No change is proposed, so no additional upkeep labour is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Actual physical assessment and interpretation remain unchanged after checking for established separate record, report or send work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
